bop_spectre_moon.screen.title: QFS Accessibility
bop_spectre_moon.screen.reload_note: Pressing Done reloads resources (can take a moment)
Biomes O' Plenty blood and flesh show as cyan ectoplasm.
bop_spectre_moon.option.vanilla_mob_skin: Cucurucho and Dark Cucurucho mobs use vanilla skins.
bop_spectre_moon.option.friendly_spiders: Spiders show as slimes with purple sparkles and sound like cats.
bop_spectre_moon.option.friendly_bugs.to: Bugs such as cockroaches, centipedes and silverfish show as small slimes and sound softer.
bop_spectre_moon.option.smooth_holes.too: Sponges, honeycomb and other blocks covered in holes or bubbles show as smooth.
bop_spectre_moon.option.sound_limiter.to: Mob and weather sounds turn down for a few seconds when a loud sound plays, then rise back.
